Both corrections are done, verified, and the corrected build is live on port 4000 (fresh, empty state).

**Please review again at: http://maker:4000**

What I fixed — both were implementation errors, so the approved scenarios are unchanged:

1. **Internet Archive link is now fully independent of the local copy.** A bookmark preserved *only* via the Internet Archive now shows its **Internet Archive** link on the card with no local copy present, and the link remains after a local saved copy is removed. When both exist, the card shows both. (Verified: archive-only card shows the IA link and no "View"; removing the local copy leaves the IA link.)

2. **Bulk "Add tag" now confirms "Tagged …".** The message was reading the mode after it had been reset; I capture it first, so **Add tag** reports *"Tagged N bookmark(s) #tag"* and only **Remove tag** reports *"Untagged …"*. (Verified both.)

I re-ran the checks for these two behaviours and they pass; the rest of the verified behaviour is unchanged.
